Bill.BriefDescription: Convening a work group to recommend standards for communication of information concerning dependent children.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to facilitating communication of informationconcerning dependent children; and amending RCW 13.34.350.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 13.34.350 and 2001 c 52 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In order to facilitate communication of information needed to servethe best interest of any child who is the subject of a dependency casefiled under this chapter, the department of social and health servicesshall((, consistent with state and federal law governing the release ofconfidential information, establish guidelines, and shall use thoseguidelines for the facilitation of)) convene a work group to recommendstandards to be used in facilitating communication ((of relevantinformation among)) with department divisions, service providers, thecourts, the family, caregivers, caseworkers, and others. The workgroup shall make recommendations regarding definitions of categories ofinformation to be used, who should have access to categories ofinformation, how long it is to be retained, how and when appropriateinformation is to be purged, compliance enforcement, and consequencesfor noncompliance. Recommendations shall address all forms of p. 1 SSB 5633information whether it is kept in electronic, magnetic, paper, or otherform of storage media. All recommendations shall be consistent withstate and federal law governing release of confidential information.The work group shall report its recommendations to the legislature byDecember 1, 2005.
